alignmentMethod: Fresh unforced whisper.cpp 1.9.2 small.en full-track word-window output compared with the earlier separate token-level DTW candidate map. The supplied lyric remains authoritative where ASR disagrees. The first hook is missed by unforced recognition and its candidate shape is borrowed from later clear repetitions. Every supplied word has an independent candidate start/end and is highlighted alone; very short events may be hard to perceive at ordinary playback speed. No complete human listening review has been recorded. Sample indices below are integer conversions of estimated second values, not sample-accurate acoustic claims.
